verdict.rationale: Pipedream ships an official `pd` CLI with a documented command reference. It can deploy event sources from local or remote code (`pd deploy`), live-sync local files to deployed components (`pd dev`), stream emitted events to the terminal, and show help for each command. A probe confirms the CLI reference exists. Missing for 10: any evidence of AI- or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., scripting by agents or machine-readable output), evidence that the CLI covers workflows beyond event sources and components, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
